stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one

reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

H=W=20
coords=set()
rows={7:[4,5,6,11,12,13],8:[6,11],9:[6,7,9,10,11,12],10:[6,7,8,9,12,13],11:[5,6,9],12:[4,5,9],13:[8,9,10,11,12,13]}
for r,cs in rows.items():
    for c in cs: coords.add((r,c))
# preserve axis cells; shift each off-axis side to nearest top corner
out=set((r,c) for r,c in coords if c==8)
left=[(r,c) for r,c in coords if c<8]
right=[(r,c) for r,c in coords if c>8]
# move side subsets to top corners preserving shape, align its row min to 0 and left/right extreme to boundary
minr=min(r for r,c in left); minc=min(c for r,c in left)
for r,c in left: out.add((r-minr,c-minc))
minr=min(r for r,c in right); maxc=max(c for r,c in right)
for r,c in right: out.add((r-minr,c+(W-1-maxc)))
# laser 2 until first axis 7
first=min(r for r,c in coords if c==8)
res=[[1]*W for _ in range(H)]
for r,c in out: res[r][c]=7
for r in range(first): res[r][8]=2
print('first',first,'coords',sorted(out))
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in res))
